_description: Request body for POST /webhook-endpoints: registers an HTTPS receiver for signed events. The response carries the signing secret, the only time it is returned.
_notes: url: https on port 443 with a public hostname; events: 1 to 4 of the four names, each once; description: optional, max 255 characters
Store the secret from this response: no other route returns it. If it is lost, delete the endpoint and create a new one
Then send a sample to the receiver: POST /webhook-endpoints/{id}/test with { "sampleEvent": "post.published" }
The receiver verifies the signature on the raw body (Standard Webhooks), deduplicates on the event id, and answers 2xx within 15 seconds
A workspace can have 5 active endpoints; the sixth returns 400 webhook.limitReached
